Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.

Sri Rupak Chaubey, learned AGA raised an objection that against the order of the Tribunal the petitioner has a remedy of appeal under Section 71(6) of Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006 and as such the present petition is not maintainable.
He has also placed reliance upon a judgment of this Court dated 12.5.2015 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 1586 of 2015 (Pradeep Kumar Gupta vs. State of U.P.).

sentences.text: At this stage, counsel for the petitioner submits that he intends to withdraw the instant writ petition with liberty to file an appeal.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
Certified copy of the documents, if any, may be returned to the counsel for the petitioner as per Rules of the Court.
